content: We need to use tools to find template IDs. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_broken etc. For amide formation forward reaction: carboxylic acid + amine -> amide. In forward direction, bond formed: C-N (amide), bond broken: C-O (carboxylic acid) maybe also O-H. functional group formed: amide; broken: carboxylic acid. Let's search.
